steps.hardClue: Collect two repair parts from the Library and Director’s Quarters office.
steps.clue: Collect the Fuse from the Library and Circuit Board from the Director’s Quarters.

steps.hardClue: Repair the elevator to access the lower facility and Pack-a-Punch.
steps.clue: Repair the elevator to reach S.A.M. and Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Kill the Lab Technician and collect the Floppy Disk.
steps.clue: Kill the Lab Technician in the Mainframe Chamber and collect the Floppy Disk.

steps.hardClue: Use the Floppy Disk to obtain a four-letter protocol word.
steps.clue: Use the Floppy Disk to obtain the Project Janus protocol word.

steps.hardClue: Decode the word using a chalkboard, then enter the resulting code underground.
steps.clue: Decode the protocol using the Nursery chalkboard, then enter the code in the Service Tunnel.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the enemy behind the coded door and collect its severed arm.
steps.clue: Defeat the HVT Doppelghast and collect its Severed Arm.

steps.hardClue: Use the severed arm on a biometric scanner to retrieve the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Use the Severed Arm on the biometric scanner to obtain the Ray Gun Mark II.

steps.hardClue: Obtain three canisters and use them to create three Wonder Weapon variants.
steps.clue: Obtain three canisters and craft Wraith Fire, Rot Blight and Preservation.

steps.hardClue: Complete the three rituals to charge the artifact.
steps.clue: Complete the three Liminal rituals to charge the Sentinel Artifact.

steps.hardClue: Give the charged artifact to the AI, then defeat the giant creature.
steps.clue: Give the charged Sentinel Artifact to S.A.M., then defeat the Z-Rex.
